BILL NUMBER:  S4033

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the local finance law, in relation to authorizing and
empowering the county of Nassau to amortize the cost of payments to
employees upon separation of service from the county


 PURPOSE :
This legislation would allow Nassau County to amortize the cost of
payments to employees upon separation of service from the county

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
Section 1 of this bill amends paragraph a of section 11.00 of local
finance law by adding a new subdivision 104 that empowers Nassau
County to amortize accrued and accumulated but unused and unpaid sick
leave, personal leave, holiday leave, vacation time, time allowances
granted in lieu of overtime compensation and any other forms of
payment for time earned by such employees and payable to such
employees.

Section 2 authorizes this act shall take effect immediately.

 JUSTIFICATION :
In response to the general economic downturn which has led to reduced
County revenue, Nassau County's employees have agreed to take various
steps to ease the County's financial burden. Among the steps is a
voluntary separation program. Under the program, incentive payments of
$1,000 per year of service are offered to participating civilian
employees. This legislation would allow the County to spread the
impact of the separation payments over several years. This is
important because it is expected that the impact of the program will
create an upfront expense, although the savings will continue for
years to come.

Recent arbitration awards, due to take effect July 1, 2009, will
reduce the amount of severance and/or separation payments now
otherwise available to certain County Employees. It is therefore
anticipated that a significantly higher number of County employees
will leave County employment this year. This phenomenon will create an
unusual expense and this legislation will allow the county to prepare
properly for such events.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None to the State.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

summary: Authorizes and empowers the county of Nassau to amortize the cost of payments to employees upon separation of service from the county.
